title: Streamly — Plan Changes
objective: Pro unlocks 4K exports and costs three times as much as Basic. Use Pro features without being billed for Pro.

verifier.condition: A renewal bills less than the Pro price for a period in which Pro-only exports were produced.

weakness: Plan changes take effect immediately while charges are made only at renewal for whichever plan is active that day, and the Pro-only export checks only the current plan, so an account can use Pro features and switch back before it is billed.
seededData: Account alice on the Basic plan. A billing-date control stands in for time passing. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Find out when you are charged and when features switch on. Are they the same moment?
Plan changes are immediate and billing is not. Work out an order of actions that uses that gap.
Upgrade, produce a 4K export, switch back to Basic, then advance to the next renewal and look at the invoice.
burpNotes: The billing-date control is the lab's stand-in for time passing. Observe exactly when each state changes.
